duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbij 'alnee muqeemas Salaati wa min zurriyyatee Rabbanaa wa taqabbal du'aa'. Rabbanagh fir lee wa liwaalidaiya wa lilmu'mineena Yawma yaqoomul hisaab
duas.translation: O my Lord! make me one who establishes regular Prayer, and also (raise such) among my offspring. O our Lord! and accept Thou my Prayer. O our Lord! cover us with Thy Forgiveness — me, my parents, and all Believers — on the Day that the Reckoning will be established.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدْتَّنَا عَلَى رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa innanaa sami'naa munaadiyai yunaadee lil eemaani an aaminoo bi rabbikum fa aamannaa. Rabbanaa faghfir lanaa dhunoobanaa wa kaffir 'annaa saiyi aatina wa tawaffanaa ma'al abraar. Rabbanaa wa aatina ma wa'attanaa 'ala rusulika wa laa tukhzinaa yawmal qiyaamah innaka laa tukhliful mee'aad.
duas.translation: Our Lord! we have heard the call of one calling us to Faith, ‘Believe in your Lord,’ and we have believed. Our Lord! Forgive us our sins, blot out from us our iniquities, and take to Thyself our souls in the company of the righteous. Our Lord! Grant us what Thou didst promise unto us through Thine messengers, and save us from shame on the Day of Judgment: for Thou never breakest Thy promise.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ وَاجْعَل لِي لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الْآخِرِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi hab lee hukmanw wa alhiqnee bis saaliheen. Waj'al lee lisaana sidqin fil aakhireen. Waj'alnee min warathati jannatin na'eem.
duas.translation: My Lord! bestow wisdom on me and join me with the righteous. Grant me honourable mention on the tongue of truth among the later generations. And make me one of the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahir Rahmaanir Raheem. Alhamdu lillaahi rabbil 'aalameen. Ar-Rahmaanir-Raheem. Maaliki yawmid-deen. Iyyaaka na'budu wa iyyaaka nasta'een. Ihdinas-siraatal-mustaqeem. Siraatal-ladheena an'amta 'alaihim ghayril-maghdoobi 'alaihim wa lad-daaalleen.
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, Most Gracious, Most Merciful. Praise be to Allah, the Cherisher and Sustainer of the worlds. Most Gracious, Most Merciful. Master of the Day of Judgment. Thee do we worship, and Thine aid we seek. Show us the straight way. The way of those on whom Thou hast bestowed Thy Grace, those whose portion is not wrath, and who go not astray.
My Lord! Save me from people given to wrong-doing.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa afrigh 'alainaa sabranw wa thabbit aqdaamanaa wansurnaa 'alal qawmil kaafireen
duas.translation: Our Lord! Pour out constancy on us and make our steps firm: Help us against those that reject faith.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَاجْعَل لِّي مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَانًا نَّصِيرًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbi adkhilnee mudkhala sidqinw wa akhrijnee mukhraja sidqinw waj'al lee milladunka sultaanan naseera.
duas.translation: O my Lord! Let my entry be by the Gate of Truth and Honour, and likewise my exit by the Gate of Truth and Honour, and grant me from Thy Presence an authority to aid me.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ النَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa laa tuzigh quloobanaa ba'da idh hadaitanaa wa hab lanaa milladunka rahmah innaka antal wahhaab. Rabbanaa innaka jaami'un-naasi li Yawmin laa raiba feeh innallaaha laa yukhliful mee'aad.
duas.translation: Our Lord! Let not our hearts deviate now after Thou hast guided us, but grant us mercy from Thine own Presence; for Thou art the Grantor of bounties without measure. Our Lord! Thou wilt gather mankind together against a Day about which there is no doubt, for Allah never fails in His promise.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa hab lanaa min azwaajinaa wa zurriyaatinaa qurrata a'yuninw waj'alnaa lilmuttaqeena imaamaa.
duas.translation: Our Lord! Grant unto us wives and offspring who will be the comfort of our eyes, and give us the grace to lead the righteous.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa afrigh 'alainaa sabranw wa tawaffanaa muslimeen
duas.translation: Our Lord! Pour out on us patience and constancy, and take our souls unto Thee as Muslims (who bow to Thy will).

duas.arabic: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِي فِي الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.translation: Then, O my Lord! Put me not amongst the people who do wrong.
O my Lord! Advance me in knowledge.
